name: stampsort-mobile
description: Vỏ iOS (Capacitor) cho prototype Stamp Sort / Little Post Office. Web build lấy từ tools/deploy_web.sh --build-only.

scripts.web: cd .. && KEEP_APK_LEVELS=1 tools/deploy_web.sh --build-only && rm -rf mobile/www && cp -R dist/web mobile/www
scripts.sync: npm run web && npx cap sync ios
